about: Strathmore is a town in southern Alberta on the Trans-Canada Highway east of Calgary, in Wheatland County prairie country. Agriculture, a growing residential base for Calgary commuters, and a compact main street shape an irrigated plains community. About 14,000 people live in Strathmore.
seoSummary: Prairie town on the Trans-Canada east of Calgary—agriculture and a growing Calgary-commuter community.
